transcript:
User: Hi — I saw your ad on Facebook about answering missed calls. I keep losing patients after hours, so I'm curious how it works.
Agent: Got it, yeah — losing patients after hours is exactly what we help with. At a high level, we set you up so when no one can answer — evenings, weekends, busy times — every call is still picked up, handled, and turned into booked appointments or detailed messages instead of voicemail.

Before I go deeper into how it works, can you tell me what usually happens now when a patient calls after hours — does it ring out, go to voicemail, or to an answering service?
User: When patients call after hours, it goes straight to voicemail, and we miss potential bookings.
Agent: Yeah, that makes sense — when it hits voicemail, a lot of people just hang up and call the next clinic. So what we do is step in at those times so every after-hours call is actually answered live, the patient’s details are taken, and we either book them into your schedule or capture everything in a structured message for your team first thing.

To get a feel for the impact: roughly how many after-hours calls a week would you say are going to voicemail right now?
User: We receive about 20 calls a week that hit voicemail after hours.
Agent: Got it, so about 20 calls a week are just hitting voicemail after hours. When that happens, do those patients usually leave a message and wait, or do you think most of them hang up and call another practice instead?
User: Most don't leave a message; I worry they hang up and go to a competitor instead.
Agent: Yeah, that’s exactly what usually happens — they don’t wait, they just call the next option on Google. 

Has anyone ever actually walked you through what that could be costing you each week in lost bookings, using your numbers?
User: No, not yet. I estimate about 10 lost bookings weekly, with each appointment worth $650.
Agent: So with your numbers, you’re roughly looking at about $6,500 a week — around $28,000 a month — walking out the door in missed bookings. 

Since stopping that leak is exactly what we focus on, would you be open to a quick 20‑minute walkthrough this week where we plug in your numbers, show how every after-hours call gets handled, and see if it makes sense for your practice?
User: Yes, please book the live call. I want to see how it works for Bright Smile Dental.
Agent: Love it — we’ll walk through exactly how this would stop those missed bookings at Bright Smile Dental. 

To get that 20‑minute call booked, what’s your first name?
User: I'm Maria Gonzales. Let's get the live call booked for tomorrow, please.
Agent: Nice to meet you, Maria. 

Quick check — is the number you’re calling from the best one to text a confirmation for the call?
User: Yes, my best contact is +13125551234. Please use this number for the confirmation.
Agent: Perfect, thanks Maria — we’ll use that Central time. 

For tomorrow, I can get you in at either 10:00 or 10:45 in the morning; which works better for you?
User: Let's book the live call for 10:45 in the morning.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that for tomorrow at 10:45 your time.
Agent: Maria, you’re all set — Jay’s booked for tomorrow at 10:45 your time, and you’ll get an SMS confirmation shortly with all the details and a link to reschedule if you need to. Really glad you called in about Bright Smile Dental; Jay’s looking forward to walking through how we stop those lost after-hours bookings. Have a great rest of your day — bye for now!
